message.content:
Here are some effective leg exercises that target all major muscle groups—quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and hip stabilizers. Try to include a mix of compound movements (which work multiple joints and muscles) and isolation exercises (which focus on a single muscle group). Aim for 2–3 sets of 8–15 reps per exercise, adjusting weight so the last few reps feel challenging but doable.

| Exercise | Primary Muscles | Tips |
|----------|-----------------|------|
| **Squats** (back, front, goblet) | Quads, hamstrings, glutes, core | Keep chest up, knees tracking over toes, depth to parallel or below |
| **Deadlifts** (conventional, sumo, Romanian) | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back, traps | Maintain neutral spine, engage core, hinge at hips |
| **Lunges** (forward, reverse, walking, Bulgarian split squat) | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Step far enough to keep knee behind toes, keep torso upright |
| **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Adjust foot placement to target different areas; avoid locking knees |
| **Step‑Ups** | Quads, glutes, calves | Use a stable platform; drive through heel |
| **Hip Thrusts / Glute Bridges** | Glutes, hamstrings | Squeeze glutes at top, avoid arching lower back |
| **Calf Raises** (standing, seated, on leg press) | Calves (gastrocnemius, soleus) | Full range of motion, pause at top and bottom |
| **Hamstring Curls** (lying, seated, Swiss ball) | Hamstrings | Control eccentric phase, avoid swinging |
| **Leg Extensions** | Quads | Use light weight, avoid locking knees |
| **Box Jumps / Plyometric Jumps** | Quads, glutes, calves, core | Focus on soft landing, use proper footwear |
| **Wall Sit** | Quads, glutes | Hold for 30–90 seconds, keep knees at 90° angle |

### Sample Weekly Split (3–4 days)

| Day | Focus | Example Routine |
|-----|-------|-----------------|
| **Day 1 – Lower Body Strength** | Squats, deadlifts, lunges, calf raises | 3×8–10 each |
| **Day 2 – Upper Body + Core** | Bench press, rows, overhead press, planks | 3×8–12 each |
| **Day 3 – Lower Body Hypertrophy** | Leg press, hip thrusts, hamstring curls, step‑ups | 4×12–15 each |
| **Day 4 – Active Recovery / Mobility** | Light cardio, foam rolling, yoga | 20–30 min |

Feel free to swap exercises or adjust volume based on your goals (strength vs. hypertrophy vs. endurance). If you’re new to weight training, start with bodyweight variations or lighter weights and gradually increase load while maintaining proper form. If you have any injuries or medical conditions, consult a qualified trainer or healthcare professional before starting a new program.
